casual1.scene: Large carriage windows catch the amber light of late afternoon; a small maintenance kit rests on the cushion beside her.
casual1.outfit: Sand-coloured short work overalls over a fitted ivory tank with a strapless bodice line and a slim halter tie, leaving her shoulders and upper back open; knee-high rubber boots.

why.scene: 열차 선택지에 없는 시간대와 내려둔 공구를 보충한다.
why.outfit: 선택한 작업 오버롤과 탱크를 유지하며 계획의 홀터·어깨 노출을 반영한다.

era.en: inside the Pokémon world, as if she simply lives there

place.en: a carriage of a Pokémon travel train with luggage racks and resting cushions

act.en: pausing between tasks with a warm mug, her tools set down beside her

ofam.en: practical clothing for her Pokémon-world job, readable through its tools
ofam.guide: her own original workwear — never a copy of an existing trainer, Gym Leader or Pokémon Center uniform

item.en: work overalls over a fitted tank top and rubber boots

casual2.scene: A foam star baton lies beside the seat, beneath violet cabinet lights during an arcade costume evening.
casual2.outfit: A coral uniform-inspired event costume with crisp lapels and decorative epaulettes: a cropped sleeveless bodice, side waist cutouts and a high-waisted mini skirt.

why.scene: 오락실 행사 맥락과 의자 옆 소품을 보충한다.
why.outfit: 유니폼풍의 옷깃과 견장을 살리며 계획의 옆트임과 복부 노출을 정한다.

place.en: an arcade hall of upright cabinets whose screens show only coloured glow

act.en: resting on a seat for a moment, catching her breath

ofam.en: a playful adult event costume inspired by an occupation or role — clearly a costume, not a real uniform, no real insignia

casual3.scene: She pauses for a sip from a clear water bottle as the surf recedes in bright afternoon sunlight.
casual3.outfit: A fully opaque rose satin 1950s pin-up lingerie set with a structured plunging bra and high-waisted high-cut bottoms, worn as a beach fashion editorial look.

why.scene: 물병 활동에 오후 빛과 밀려나는 파도를 더한다.
why.outfit: 50년대 핀업 속옷 세트를 유지하며 계획의 하이컷과 깊은 목선을 반영한다.

place.en: a sunny beach with wet sand and shallow surf

act.en: catching her breath with a water bottle

ofam.en: a period look from a past decade
